detailed_description: The Epoch Converter tool facilitates bidirectional conversion between Unix timestamps (Epoch time) and human-readable date-time formats. Technically, Unix timestamps represent the number of seconds (or milliseconds) elapsed since 00:00:00 UTC on January 1, 1970, excluding leap seconds. This tool parses numerical inputs as Epoch values, converts them into ISO 8601-compliant datetime strings (e.g., '2024-03-20T14:30:45Z'), and supports reverse operations for date-to-timestamp conversions. Key use cases include debugging log files containing Epoch timestamps, synchronizing time-sensitive API transactions (e.g., OAuth token expiration), and normalizing timestamp formats across distributed systems. The converter handles precision variations (10-digit seconds, 13-digit milliseconds) and accounts for timezone offsets via UTC alignment. Internally, it employs JavaScript's Date.parse() for ISO/RFC 2822 format recognition and implements mathematical division/multiplication for unit conversions. Users can also customize output localization through format specifiers like 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' or 'RFC 2822'.
usage_steps: Select conversion mode using the toggle: 'Epoch to DateTime' or 'DateTime to Epoch'.
Enter a numeric timestamp (e.g., 1711137045) or a date string (e.g., '2024-03-20 14:30:45') in the primary input field.
For Epoch inputs: choose unit precision via the dropdown (Seconds, Milliseconds).
For DateTime inputs: select the source timezone (UTC, Local, or custom offset) using the timezone selector.
Click the 'Convert' button to execute the transformation.
Copy the converted result from the output box using the 'Copy to Clipboard' icon for integration into code or documentation.
usage_examples: A DevOps engineer converts a server log entry timestamp '1700000000' to '2023-11-13 04:53:20 UTC' to investigate incidents during a specific window.
An API developer generates an OAuth 2.0 token expiration value by converting '2025-01-01 00:00:00 UTC' to Epoch milliseconds (1735689600000).
A data analyst transforms a PostgreSQL timestamp column (TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE) into Epoch seconds for compatibility with a legacy reporting tool.
A systems administrator calculates a cron job schedule by converting '2024-12-31 23:59:59 UTC-0500' to Epoch (1735676399) to verify execution timing.
